heat_api_cfn_service_name.description: The service name as reported in LSB header (e.g., 'heat-api-cfn')

heat_api_cfn_desc.description: Short human-readable description of the service

heat_api_cfn_suffix.description: Suffix appended to project_name to form the process name (e.g., 'api-cfn')

heat_api_cfn_uwsgi_port.description: Port uWSGI binds to for HTTP/HTTPS (uncommented in template)

heat_api_cfn_uwsgi_threads.description: Number of threads per uWSGI worker

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user under which the service runs

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group under which the service runs

CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to Heat's main configuration file
